PAIRING ARTEFACT — comparer fixed. Print (feat-8076): "You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet; if you already have a base swim Speed, it increases by 5 feet." Ours is one formula holding both branches (speeds.swim = min(@actor.speed.swim,1)*(@actor.speed.swim-10)+15); theirs is IF SPEED_SWIM > 0 THEN adjValue +5 ELSE setValue 15. wg-values evaluated the formula only at zero, so the base (15) matched and the delta (+5) read as granted by nobody. The formula is now evaluated at a nonzero probe too and the delta asserted, only when it actually reads the character's own Speed.

PAIRING ARTEFACT — comparer fixed generically. One printed entry (equipment-3593) is FOUR records on our side and ONE row on theirs: their single row states all four grades as FEAT_NAMES-gated conditionals (+1/+2/+3/+4) and ours carries razmiri-mask +1, -silver +2, -gold +3, -porcelain +4 (situationalBonuses.ts:2191/2337-2339) — the same numbers, grade for grade. wg-values now credits the situational magnitudes of every record sharing this record's aonId, which is the printed entry's own identity (not a name prefix).

PAIRING ARTEFACT — comparer fixed generically. Print (class-feature-1017): "Increase the status bonus to your Speeds from stylish combatant to a +10-foot status bonus; this bonus increases by 5 feet at 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels. When you don't have panache, you still get half this status bonus." Their row enumerates every rung (panache 10/15/20/25/30, half 5/10/15); ours states the base and the step in the star's prose plus the always-on half as landSpeedBonus = 5+5*min(2,floor((@actor.level-3)/8)). Two comparer holes closed: (1) ordinals in a bonus string were scanned as MAGNITUDES, so 7/11/15/19 were filed as bonuses we grant — an assertion we do not make, which can only launder a difference, corpus-wide across 98 stars; (2) a ladder spelled as base + step now has its rungs computed. A formula-valued landSpeedBonus also no longer asserts NaN.
